content.push(localize('chat.persistentProgress', "The chat.experimental.persistentProgress setting defaults to Draw in all versions of VS Code. Choose Draw, Draw (Monochrome), or Draw (Monochrome, No Icon) to keep a working progress indicator at the bottom until the response finishes. When the response finishes, its toolbar takes the indicator's place. Draw ties and unravels the VS Code mark with fast parabolic ribbon motion and a brief rest between loops. The No Icon variant hides only the decorative VS Code icon; progress text and spoken updates are unchanged. The chat.experimental.persistentProgressVerbosity setting defaults to Compact: tool calls preview while running, then collapse in place to a single summary row when thinking or response text resumes, or the response finishes. Choose Verbose to keep tool chains expanded without a group header or an internal scrolling limit. Use Tab to focus a summary and press Enter or Space to expand or collapse its tool calls. Automatic collapse waits until keyboard focus leaves the group. Completed responses still follow chat.agent.collapseCompletedResponses. Reasoning appears separately as collapsible previews; focus a reasoning header and press Enter or Space to expand or collapse it. Standalone tools keep their decorative icons. Terminal activity animations and subagent pills are unchanged. The indicator reports counts of running subagents and background commands, including work started in earlier requests, whether the main response is progressing or idle. Requests for your input, approval, plan review, or authentication take priority over these counts. After 90 seconds without response activity and with no active tools, progress tasks, or known background work, it reports that the response is taking longer than usual. Long-running foreground terminal commands do not trigger this message. Reduced motion disables the collapse animation and keeps the indicator visible without animation. Spoken progress updates are controlled by accessibility.verboseChatProgressUpdates."));
